title: Prefix-labelled junction deletion contribution
statement:
Let X be a scheme, I a linearly ordered type, U : I -> X.Opens, F an abelian-group-valued presheaf, S a SiteCechComplex for the maps U_i -> X [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex], p a natural number, s a degree-(p+1) cochain, and t : Fin (p+2) -> I. Use the stable sorting filter, partial sorting filter, and junction map [def-pc-alternating-cech-sorting-operators]. Define E and B by the following displayed formulas. The sum of junction-labelled deletions with r <= a equals the sum of unadvanced partial sorting contributions B_a.

let E := fun (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2))) (a : Fin (p + 2))
        (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2))) (r : Fin (p + 3)) ↦
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ a.val * (Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ)) •
        F.map (S.indexMap t (cechJunction σ τ a)).op
          ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val •
            F.map (S.indexMap (t ∘ cechJunction σ τ a) r.succAbove).op
              (s ((t ∘ cechJunction σ τ a) ∘ r.succAbove)))
    let P := ∑ σ, ∑ a, ∑ τ, ∑ r,
      if ((cechStableSort t σ ∧ cechPartialSort σ τ a) ∧
          cechJunction σ τ a r = σ a) ∧ r.val ≤ a.val then E σ a τ r else 0
    let B : ℕ → S.cochains F (p + 1) := fun a t ↦
      ∑ σ, ∑ τ, if cechStableSort t σ ∧
          (∀ k, k.val < a → τ k = σ k) ∧
          (∀ i j, a ≤ i.val → i < j → τ i < τ j) then
        (Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ) • F.map (S.indexMap t τ).op (s (t ∘ τ)) else 0
    P = ∑ a : Fin (p + 2), B a.val t

proof.text: For any prefix deletion position r, unfold cechJunction in its prefix branch. Injectivity of sigma shows that cechJunction sigma tau a r = sigma a and r.val <= a.val hold if and only if r = a.castSucc. This is prefix_junction_filter.

Under cechPartialSort sigma tau a, deleting a.castSucc from the junction recovers tau as a function. Below a, succAbove is castSucc and the fixed-prefix condition identifies sigma k with tau k. At or above a, succAbove is succ and the tail branch is tau k. This is prefix_junction_delete.

Parallel morphisms in X.Opens are equal. Thus the opposite index map for a composite equals the composite of the opposite index maps. Functor.map_comp gives the local composite transport equality; rewrite the recovered junction deletion tuple to tau. Move integer scalar multiplication through F.map and combine the scalars. The product of the two powers (-1)^a is one, leaving sign(tau).

Commute the outer sigma and a sums and compare summands for each a, sigma, tau. If stable and partial sorting hold, prefix_junction_filter and Finset.sum_ite_eq reduce the r sum to a.castSucc, and the previous transport and coefficient identities give its B summand. Otherwise both sides vanish because the B filter is definitionally stable sorting and cechPartialSort. Finset.sum_congr assembles the equality.

theorem cechFirstSortingJunctionPrefixContribution (X : Scheme.{u}) {I : Type v}
    [LinearOrder I] (U : I → X.Opens)
    (F : X.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{w})
    (S : SiteCechComplex U (fun i ↦ homOfLE (le_top : U i ≤ ⊤)))
    (p : ℕ) (s : S.cochains F (p + 1)) (t : Fin (p + 2) → I) :
    let E := fun (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2))) (a : Fin (p + 2))
        (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (p + 2))) (r : Fin (p + 3)) ↦
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ a.val * (Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ)) •
        F.map (S.indexMap t (cechJunction σ τ a)).op
          ((-1 : ℤ) ^ r.val •
            F.map (S.indexMap (t ∘ cechJunction σ τ a) r.succAbove).op
              (s ((t ∘ cechJunction σ τ a) ∘ r.succAbove)))
    let P := ∑ σ, ∑ a, ∑ τ, ∑ r,
      if ((cechStableSort t σ ∧ cechPartialSort σ τ a) ∧
          cechJunction σ τ a r = σ a) ∧ r.val ≤ a.val then E σ a τ r else 0
    let B : ℕ → S.cochains F (p + 1) := fun a t ↦
      ∑ σ, ∑ τ, if cechStableSort t σ ∧
          (∀ k, k.val < a → τ k = σ k) ∧
          (∀ i j, a ≤ i.val → i < j → τ i < τ j) then
        (Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ) • F.map (S.indexMap t τ).op (s (t ∘ τ)) else 0
    P = ∑ a : Fin (p + 2), B a.val t
